entities.name: Sunčana Škrinjarić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sunčana Škrinjarić was a Croatian writer, poet and journalist. She became known by writing children's books, such as Kaktus bajke, Pisac i vrijeme, Slikar u šumi, Pisac i princeza, Ulica predaka and Kazališna kavana.
